title: Dining Plan Enrollment Eligibility and the Independent Living Minimum Plan
content:
Dining Plan eligibility rests on the independent living residency. Dining plans serve independent living residents only; because assisted living and memory care residents may not hold a dining plan on any plan of the Dining Plan, assisted living and memory care residents, whose meals are included in their own agreements, cannot enroll.

## The conditions of enrollment

1. **Residency.** The customer must hold an independent living residency in reserved, active or notice given status. The status is the one shown on the company's record of that independent living residency - the residency the plan will serve - and it is checked before the enrollment is made; what the customer says about the residency does not replace the record. A residency in any other status does not satisfy this condition.
2. **Minimum plan.** Holding an independent living apartment other than an Independent Living Cottage Home requires a dining plan of rank at least 2 from the move-in date. Independent Living Cottage Home residents are exempt from the minimum on every plan, so the Dining 10 Meal Plan, of rank 1, is available only to cottage residents.
3. **Start.** A plan starts on the 1st of a month. At enrollment the plan opens in pending start status and becomes active on its effective date, the first day of a month.
4. **Withdrawal.** An enrollment may be withdrawn before the plan starts, without charge; the plan then ends without having started.

## Decision table: residency and apartment

| Independent living residency status | Apartment | Plans open to the customer |
|---|---|---|
| Reserved, active or notice given | Independent Living Cottage Home | Any plan, rank 1 to 6, including the Dining 10 Meal Plan |
| Reserved, active or notice given | Any other independent living apartment | Rank 2 and above: the Dining 15, 30, 45 and 60 Meal Plans and the Dining Full Board Plan |
| Any other status | Any | None |
| No independent living residency (for example, an assisted living or memory care resident only) | - | None |

## Cases (hypothetical customers)

- A prospective resident whose independent living residency is reserved for a non-cottage apartment asks for the Dining 15 Meal Plan: the residency status qualifies and the plan's rank of 2 meets the minimum, so the enrollment may be made, the plan starting on the 1st of a month.
- The same prospective resident asks for the Dining 10 Meal Plan: rank 1 is below the minimum of 2 for a non-cottage apartment, so that plan is not available.
- A cottage resident in notice given status asks for the Dining 10 Meal Plan: the status qualifies and the cottage exemption applies, so the plan is available.
- A resident who enrolled on the 10th of a month for a plan starting on the 1st of the following month withdraws on the 25th, before the start: the withdrawal carries no charge.
